verses.mystical_translation: O the Living Presence, our Holy Presence, how excellent is your name in all the earth! who hast set your glory above the heavens.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
What is humanity, that you remember them, and a human being, that you attend to them?
Yet you have made humanity a little lower than the divine beings [elohim], and crowned them with glory and honor.
You madest him to have dominion over the works of your hands; you have put all things under his feet:
All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatever passeth through the paths of the seas.
O the Living Presence our Holy Presence, how excellent is your name in all the earth!

contemplative_note: Human dignity is held inside wonder, not above the living world.
safety_note: Human “dominion” is not a license for ecological exploitation, cruelty, or claims of superiority over vulnerable people.
